description: This file implements part of the CCSP CWMP protocol, specifically the function to retrieve HTTP credentials for ACS connection. It contains licensing information, includes, a function definition, and associated comments.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpAcscoHttpGetCredential(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pHostName,USHORT HostPort,PUCHAR pUriPath,PUCHAR * ppUserName,PUCHAR * ppPassword)
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP authentication credentials (username and password) for a given ACS connection session, either from the session's processor or from the object’s stored credentials.
